title: Waypoint: Analytically Modeling GEMM for CPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.34914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-performance General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) implementations rely on breaking down GEMM into carefully selected tiles to achieve peak performance. We present Waypoint, a new analytical model to automatically identify the optimal tile size for a given hardware and input matrix shape. Waypoint estimates the achievable performance for a given tile choice by capturing all the architectural effects including interactions with memory hierarchy, instruction-level parallelism, and multi-threading. Using the estimates as a proxy, we search through the space of possible tile sizes to identify the one that maximizes performance. Additionally, Waypoint helps hardware designers estimate realistic performance on experimental hardware optimizations. We build a new GEMM library OPAM for CPUs that uses Waypoint to automatically break down GEMM and achieve performance that matches state-of-the-art GEMM libraries and helps accelerate LLM inferen

translated_abstract: 高性能的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）实现依赖于将GEMM分解为精心选择的分块以达到峰值性能。我们提出了Waypoint，这是一种新的解析模型，可自动为给定的硬件和输入矩阵形状确定最优分块大小。Waypoint通过捕捉所有架构效应——包括与内存层次结构的交互、指令级并行和多线程——来估计给定分块选择所能达到的性能。以这些估计作为代理，我们在可能的分块大小空间中进行搜索，以确定性能最大化的分块。此外，Waypoint还帮助硬件设计者评估实验性硬件优化的真实性能。我们构建了一个新的面向CPU的GEMM库OPAM，它使用Waypoint自动分解GEMM，实现了与最先进GEMM库相当的性能，并有助于加速大语言模型（LLM）推理。
tldr: 提出了解析模型Waypoint，通过捕捉内存层次、指令级并行和多线程等架构效应，自动为CPU确定GEMM的最优分块大小，并据此构建了性能媲美最先进库且可加速LLM推理的GEMM库OPAM。
en_tdlr: Waypoint is an analytical model that automatically identifies optimal GEMM tile sizes for CPUs by capturing architectural effects including memory hierarchy, instruction-level parallelism, and multi-threading, enabling a new GEMM library OPAM that matches state-of-the-art performance and helps accelerate LLM inference.
